transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, this is Jake. How can I help you?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Jake. My router keeps restarting by itself every few hours, and it cuts off my calls on wifi. It's been happening for a week and I'm fed up.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: A week of that would wear anyone down, I'm sorry, Thandiwe. Can I take your PIN, please?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. So your router has been restarting itself every few hours for a week, and it drops your wifi calls. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Does it restart at particular times, or at random?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Random, as far as I can tell.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is the router somewhere warm, like in a cupboard or next to a radiator?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's in a cupboard with the boiler, actually.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. That could be overheating. Router faults are the hardware team's area, though, so you'd have to call them on their own number, 0800 112 233, for a replacement.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can't you just do it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm afraid it's not something I can book from here. But in the meantime, if you move the router out of the cupboard, it might stop.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. I'll move it now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Right, it's on the hallway shelf now. It's come back on.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. Give it a minute. Is the wifi back on your phone?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it's connected.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good. Could you make a quick wifi call to check it holds?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Calling my sister now. Yes, it's working, no drop.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Lovely, so it's working on the shelf for now. Is that okay for today, Thandiwe?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, for now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net. Have a good afternoon.
